title: TranscriptPage
description: What `GET /transcripts/:engine/:id/messages` answers: a page of a conversation, newest page first and oldest first within it (plan 28, B-12).

session.description: The conversation the page is of.

nextCursor.description: The id of the message the next page — what came before — starts from, or `null` at the first message.

lastMessageId.description: The last entry of the conversation, `null` when it has none — what `transcript.follow` takes as `afterMessageId`.
